description: Three-part printed housing for the busy board PCB v0.1 (100 x 100 mm): a play-side panel with the display and bar-graph windows, 16 LED holes, four 24 mm arcade buttons, two panel pots and an EC11 encoder; a back tray with a 3 x AAA battery compartment behind the board; and a screwed battery door. No fixing or solder joint is reachable from the play side.

hardware.notes: Timer, B, C and power; held by its own panel nut, no push-on cap

hardware.item: B10K panel pot with anti-rotation lug
hardware.notes: M7 bushing; set pot_hole_d to 9.8 for a 3/8 inch bushing

hardware.item: EC11 rotary encoder, panel-mount (bushing and nut)

hardware.notes: On the pots and the encoder; no push-on knobs

hardware.item: 3 x AAA battery holder with leads
hardware.notes: Leads crimped to a JST-XH housing for J1

hardware.item: M3 heat-set insert (4.6 mm OD, up to 6 mm long)
hardware.notes: Four PCB bosses, six tray posts, one door boss; set insert_hole_d to 2.6 for self-tapping screws instead
From the board's back into the panel bosses
Through the tray floor into the panel posts
Under D1-D16 so the lens tips just enter the panel holes

hardware.item: Cable tie, up to 3 mm wide
hardware.notes: Control leads through the two panel tie loops

printing_notes: Print all three parts as exported, without supports: the panel play-face down, the tray floor down, the door outer-face down. PETG or ASA, 3 perimeters.
Press the eleven M3 heat-set inserts (four PCB bosses, six posts, the door boss) before assembly.

Seat the ring LEDs D1-D16 on 7 mm spacers so the lenses just enter the panel holes; the 5.8 mm flange cannot pass, so no lens stands proud. Seat DS1, BG1 and BG2 flat or on socket strips; they show through the windows from behind.

Assembly order: panel face down; fit the buttons, pots and encoder with their panel nuts (pot and encoder lugs in their slots) and the set-screw knobs; board onto the four bosses with M3 x 6 from its back; control leads over the board's bottom edge to J2-J8 via the two tie loops; battery holder into the compartment from the back with its leads through the notch to J1; tray on; six M3 x 10 from the back; door last with its M3 x 8.
The battery door needs a screwdriver to open (adult-only access); the programming header J9 is only reachable with the tray off.

VERIFY against the delivered parts and adjust: arcade button depth, nut and switch reach (button_depth, button_nut_d, button_switch_reach); pot and encoder bushings (pot_hole_d, enc_hole_d) and lug radii (pot_lug_r, enc_lug_r); knob diameter (knob_d); battery holder size (batt_l, batt_w, batt_h); and the JST-XH lead room (raise pcb_to_panel and led_raise together).

wall, corner_r, edge_r, inner_d and insert_hole_d and pcb_to_panel are shared by the panel and the tray, and floor_t, batt_l, batt_w, door_t and door_clear by the tray and the door: set them identically on every part that exposes them.
